title: Dutch-Style Shrimp Frittata
description: A hearty and flavorful breakfast dish from the Netherlands, featuring succulent shrimp and a rich, creamy egg mixture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit (190 degrees Celsius).
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the frittata and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked shrimp and onions.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
